spec: Part VIII 8.1 — V57–V65, reserved by A16 and allocated by the nutrition addendum §7 (RATIFIED 2026-09-18; Q1 maintenance only, Q2 calories as a fourth line): target derivation, the carbs floor, remaining macros, idempotent logging, no XP for an entry (clause ③, load-bearing), the bodyweight lives inside the targets, and the 18+ gate (A16.c · A22 G3).

vectors.title: derive targets at 80 kg
vectors.rule: 80.0 kg: energy 80 × 33 = 2640 → 2650 (rounds to energyKcalRoundTo); protein 80 × 1.8 = 144 → 145; fat max(20 % of 2650 ÷ 9 = 58.9 → 60, floor 0.5 × 80 = 40) = 60; carbs (2650 − 580 − 540) ÷ 4 = 382.5 → 385. Grams round half-up to macroGramsRoundTo.

vectors.title: 176 lb derives the same four lines as 80 kg
vectors.rule: 176.0 lb is 79.83 kg by the exact international pound (integer half-up). The rounding steps absorb the difference: the same energy, protein, fat and carbs as V57 — a unit preference never changes a target.

vectors.title: the fat floor holds at the lightest and the heaviest bodyweight
vectors.rule: Fat is never below fatFloorGramsPerKg × kg. With the ratified maintenance factors the energy rule gives 0.73 g/kg, above the 0.5 g/kg floor at every bodyweight, so the floor is a guard that never binds (R-074): at 30.0 kg fat is 20 (floor 15); at 150.0 kg fat is 110 (floor 75).

vectors.title: carbs floor at zero and the overage is stated
vectors.rule: Carbs are what the energy leaves after protein and fat. When protein and fat alone exceed it (grams the user typed), carbs are 0 and the overage is a number on its own line — a measurement, never a warning. The derived case shows the ordinary remainder.

vectors.title: remaining = target − logged, floored at zero; over is the other side
vectors.rule: Each line carries logged, target, toGo and over; toGo and over are never both above 0. The calorie line is the macros in Atwater kilocalories on both sides (4 · 4 · 9), so it agrees with the grams the user set.

vectors.title: a template slot logs its saved meal's grams once (idempotent clientId)
vectors.rule: A log is idempotent on its clientId: the same slot tapped twice — or replayed by the queue — logs once; a second entry with its own clientId is a second log.

vectors.title: a meal log is never a game event: zero XP, no streak, no day.meals (load-bearing, clause ③)
vectors.spec: 8.1 V63; Flow 4 clause ③; nutrition addendum §2
vectors.rule: gameEvents(logs) is empty for any day of logs, so folding it over a state changes nothing: no XP, no streak, no shield, no achievement. This is the single place a macro entry could ever become a game event.

vectors.title: the bodyweight lives inside the targets: delete them and none is left
vectors.rule: bodyweightOf(targets) reads the one bodyweight in the system out of the targets document; with the targets deleted (null) there is no bodyweight anywhere.

vectors.title: the nutrition surface is unreachable for a 17-year-old
vectors.spec: 8.1 V65; A16.c; nutrition addendum §6; A22 G3
vectors.rule: currentYear − birthYear ≥ nutritionAdultAgeYears → available; younger → absent (no row, no copy, no upsell); no birth year on the account → askBirthYear, once, when Nutrition is opened.
